reviewed_value_flow.consumer: core setEffect floors dur and assigns p.dur. Campaign checks hasEffect(EFF_TWILIT_ECHOES).
ECHOED_LIGHT.activate adds -power to global_speed_add. Core speed is base/(1+abs(global_speed_add)), floored at 0.1; displayed strength is not literal fractional reduction of final global speed.
Initial core setEffect assigns p.dur=3; subsequent on_merge returns old_eff and core returns immediately without refreshing old dur.

Initial activate is uncapped. on_merge max=math.max(old.max,new.max), old.power=math.min(old.power+new.power,max). It can lower a previously uncapped large power; target deliberately says recalculate, not guaranteed increase.
reviewed_value_flow.display_caveat: %d formats a possibly noninteger displayed cap; no claim of exact final speed reduction.

reviewed_value_flow.consumer: Equivalent damage sum for slow power cap when adding dam*0.001. Not a clamp on first hit. %d is display formatting of this computed equivalent.

Initial Map.addEffect duration is literal 4, not this display parameter. Existing same-tile live dark echo refreshes only for DARKNESS and 0<duration<eff.echo_dur, assigns duration=3. Map projects damage before decrementing duration; a self-triggered refresh to 3 during that tick ends at 2 after decrement.

reviewed_value_flow.parameter: action dam_factor -> eff.dam_factor; initial addEffect dam=dam*factor
reviewed_value_flow.consumer: Map DamageType projector consumes echo.dam each eligible map tick. Refresh old_total=old_duration*old_per_tick; new_per_tick=(incoming_damage*factor*3+old_total)/3. Thus displayed factor is the base new contribution, not total refreshed tick damage or a percentage of original damage divided by duration.
reviewed_value_flow.display_caveat: %d formats scaling result; no guarantee on eventual mitigated damage or lifetime total while refresh continues.
